resources.string: Faka ilanga le-Hijri ukuthola i-Arafah, i-An-Nahr kanye namalanga we-Tashreeq
Faka ilanga le-Hijri ukubona i-Arafah, i-An-Nahr kanye namalanga we-Tashreeq
Faka ilanga elisebenzako le-Hijri. Umnyaka ukusuka ku-1300 ukuya ku-1600, inyanga ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-12, ilanga ukusuka ku-1 ukuya ku-30.

Faka nanyana ngiliphi ilanga le-Hijri (nofana ugcine ilanga lamanje) ukuthola amalanga we-Hajj womnyaka wayo: iLanga le-Arafah (9 Dhul-Hijjah), iLanga le-An-Nahr (10 Dhul-Hijjah) kanye namalanga we-Tashreeq (11, 12 no-13 Dhul-Hijjah), ngalinye linelanga layo elilingana ne-Gregorian nendawo yakho.
Insika ekulu kunazo zoke: yima e-Arafah kusukela ngemva kwemini bekube sekutjhingeni kwelanga, wenze ukuncenga okukhulu, i-takbir ne-tahlil. Umphorofidi (PBUH) wathi: "I-Hajj yi-Arafah."
I-Eid al-Adha: yitje i-Jamarat al-Aqabah ngamatje alikhomba, unikele ngomhlabelo, uphuce nofana usike, bese wenza i-Tawaf al-Ifadah ne-Sai.
Isaziso samalanga woke esikukhumbuza ngesiko elihlosiweko ngesikhathi samalanga we-Hajj (8-13 Dhul-Hijjah)
Isaziso samalanga woke esikukhumbuza ngesiko elihlosiweko ngesikhathi samalanga we-Hajj (8-13 Dhul-Hijjah)
I-sunnah yalelilanga: ngena i-ihram, iya e-Mina begodu uhlale lapho, uphindaphinda i-Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk", bese uthandaza lapho ngokufitjhani ngaphandle kokuhlanganisa.
Ngamatje ama-Jamarat amathathu ngemva kwemini: amancani, bese kuba phakathi, bese kuba amakhulu, amatje alikhomba ngamunye ngesikhathi uthi i-takbir, unxusa ngemva kwamatje amancani namaphakathi.

Phinda ukukhanda ngamatje ama-Jamarat amathathu ngemva kwemini njengayizolo. Nanyana ngubani ofuna ukurhaba angatjhiya i-Mina ngaphambi kokutjhinga kwelanga; nanyana ngubani ohlalako ulala ubusuku begodu atjhaye ngamatje ngelanga lesithathu.
Ngamatje ama-Jamarat amathathu ngemva kwemini, bese uphetha i-Hajj nge-Tawaf yokuvalelisa lokha nawutjhiya i-Makkah. Kwangathi u-Allah angamukela i-Hajj yakho.

Ireferensi epheleleko ye-Hajj ne-Umrah: ihlathululo nemithetho, imihlobo yamasiko, i-mawaqit, amasiko ngesinyathelo ngesinyathelo ngokuhlakanipha kwawo nokuthi khuyini okufanele ithini esiteshini ngasinye, ukuvinjelwa kwe-ihram, kanye nezincengo. Khetha isigaba ofisa ukusihlola.
Amagama wabo, ama-sunnah, nokuthi umlaleli kufanele athini
Imithetho yokuzila ukudla, ukuqeda kwakho kanye nama-sunnah
Ukusuka ekuvakatjheleni abagulako ukuya ekuhlanzeni, ukungcwaba nokududuza
Umhlahlandlela opheleleko: amasiko ngesinyathelo ngesinyathelo, ukuhlakanipha kwawo, kanye nezincengo
Yini ephula ukuhlambulula nomthandazo, nokuthi yini engaphuli
Ukukholelwa ku-Allah, iingilozi zakhe, iincwadi, iinthunywa, iLanga lokugcina nesimiso saphezulu
Iinsika ezihlanu lapho ikolo yakhiwe khona
Imithandazo yokuzithandela eqinisekisiweko ngaphambi nangemva kwaleyo ebophekileko
Umthandazo ngesinyathelo ngesinyathelo, ukusuka ku-takbir ukuya ku-taslim
Ukuthoma nokuphela kwemithandazo emihlanu yangelanga ngayinye
Imibandela etlhogekako ukobana umthandazo ube semthethweni
Imibandela yayo, i-nisab kanye neengaba ezisibhozo zabamukeli

UmPhrofethi صلى الله عليه وسلم wathi: “U-Allah unamagama amatjhumi alithoba nesithoba, alikhulu ngaphasi kwelilodwa; nanyana ngubani owabalako uzakungena ePharadesi.” Thepha nanyana ngiliphi ibizo ukufunda ihlathululo yalo epheleleko, ihlathululo nobufakazi obuvela ku-Quran.
